currentEvidence.flushOrder: C588 first loads B and, if nonzero, reads B+0; that value is discarded. Nontiled and nonrecording state selects BAE8; nonzero output count selects B818(G,4 dwords,alignment 4), and a nonzero pointer selects BD98 with r7=0. Always call C400, ignoring its r3. Then, if reloaded recording is clear, word 82F9B0A4!=0 and G2ABD bit 02 clear, call BE70(G,U(P-2),0,0,0), then set bit 02 without testing its success. Return zero-extended reloaded G30, not any descendant's residual r3. Prior failed allocation and accounting effects remain; count 0 still reaches C400.
currentEvidence.waitInitialization: CAA8(X,G,reason) makes six stores: X+0=low32G,+4=reason,+8=word(B),+C=K,+10=K,+14=low32timebase, with T=word(r13+100), K=word(T+58). It has no frame or call, preserves full incoming r3=X and r4/r5, changes only r10/r11, and does not change architectural condition, exception, link or floating registers in this body. CBB8/CAD8 positively read these fields.
currentEvidence.waitPoll: CBB8 has frame 112, save 29..31 and LR, and a fixed delay sequence. G2ABD bit 02 returns 0 immediately. Otherwise read cached/current B+0 and K; on changed completed word reread B+0 and store X+C=K then X+8=that second value. Call current-thread getter 8280DA68; when it equals G2A88 and G2AFC!=0, refresh X+C=K. U(K-word(X+0xC))<5000 returns full64 one. Otherwise A5B48(G) nonzero low32 returns full64 zero; zero refreshes X+C and returns one. The return is continue-or-stop control, not completion or allocation success. native-renderer-tiling-worker-store.json#/currentEvidence/watchdogBoundary/recoveryHelper defines the selected helper status overwrite: after the normal kept return the watchdog returns 1 even for the helper scalar 0xFFFFFFFF80004005. Poll stop therefore does not establish recovery or completion success; the fixed fill and copy have limits stated in recoveryHelper.fill255Boundary and copy256Boundary. externalRootBoundary/ordinal59StorageLoaderBoundary ties the pinned debug-monitor storage and BE32 root import write, each applying only under a condition. externalRootBoundary/rexAppConfigurationBoundary adds the callback and configuration, which apply only under a condition, and presentation order through the immediate virtual ConstructRuntime request. Next tie the title override and Runtime initialization and load edges to the same runtime and resolver, then active M, V, slot and lifetime, before selecting 0x826A7C48.
currentEvidence.waitExit: CAD8 has frame 96 and LR spill. Reason 0 skips timing and callback work. For nonzero reason let d=U(lowTBnow-lowTBstart): reason 3 adds zero-extended d to BE64 G5468; other reasons to G5460. Reload G and installed G347C after that store. Nonzero callback receives r3=0,r4=reason,f1 from the ordered float conversion and scaling using G5458 and constant 8216A530; callback r3 survives. Without callback, full incoming r3=X survives. Preserve selected float, FPSCR, CTR, LR and live outputs and conversion slot, not a guessed status value.
currentEvidence.retainedPressure: C400's normal tail uses a=U(actual post-BD98 r28+0x1F)&FFFFFFE0; rollover instead publishes r28-4 then C270. C270's distinct prefailed, new-failure and success stores and allocator outputs remain accepted interfaces. Selected BE70 precedes G3A5C clearing. Recording and tiled cursor readers, BCA8 fence and CPU publication order, BAE8 output and atomic semantics and B818 mutable accounting, failure, threshold and two-take order remain separate obligations.
currentEvidence.retainedReaders: Next polls consume X+C/+8; wait exit reads X+0/+4/+10/+14. Present, query and profiling paths read G5460/G5468, so diagnostic naming is not omission evidence. Metadata and later dirty emitters use C588's returned cursor; C7A8 reloads G30/G34 and can still roll over. B+0 completion, B+4 storage progress, RPTR B+3C, S2 acknowledgement and N participation remain distinct.

C588 is not allocator-independent merely because allocation occurs in callees; BAE8/B818/C400/C270 and waits can still run. Do not roll back prior effects or predict final cursor from entry G30.
